verses.text: "Do not spread false stories. Do not help a guilty person by telling lies in court.
Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you speak in court, do not side with the crowd to twist justice.
And do not favour a poor person in his case just because he is poor.
If you come across your enemy's ox or donkey wandering off, be sure to take it back to him.
If you see the donkey of someone who hates you lying under its load, do not walk away. Be sure to help him with it.
Do not deny justice to poor people in their court cases.
Stay far away from false charges. Do not put to death someone who is innocent and right, because I will not let the guilty go free.
Do not take a bribe, because a bribe blinds those who can see, and twists the words of people who are right.
Do not oppress a foreigner. You know how it feels to be a foreigner, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
For six years plant your fields and gather their crops.

But in the seventh year let the land rest and do not plant it. Then the poor among your people can get food from it, and the wild animals can eat what they leave. Do the same with your vineyards and your olive trees.
Do your work in six days, but on the seventh day rest. Then your ox and your donkey can rest, and your slaves and the foreigners living with you can be refreshed.
Be careful to do everything I have told you. Do not call on the names of other gods. Do not even let their names be heard on your lips.
Three times a year you must hold a feast for me.

Celebrate the Feast of Bread Without Yeast. For seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the set time in the month of Abib, because in that month you came out of Egypt. No one is to come before me empty-handed.

Celebrate the Feast of Harvest with the first crops from what you have planted in your fields. And celebrate the Feast of Gathering at the end of the year, when you gather in your crops from the fields.
Three times a year all your men must come before the Lord GOD.
Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me together with anything made with yeast. Do not keep the fat of my feast offerings until morning.
Bring the best of the first crops from your land to the house of the LORD your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.
Look, I am sending an angel ahead of you to protect you on the way and to bring you to the place I have made ready.
Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him. He will not forgive your rebellion, because my name is in him.
If you listen carefully to what he says and do everything I tell you, I will be an enemy to your enemies, and I will fight those who fight you.
My angel will go ahead of you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
Do not bow down to their gods or worship them, or follow their ways. You must completely destroy their gods and smash their sacred stones.
Worship the LORD your God, and he will bless your food and your water. I will take sickness away from among you.
No woman in your land will lose her baby or be unable to have children. I will give you a full life.
I will send my terror ahead of you, and I will throw into confusion every nation you meet. I will make all your enemies turn and run.
I will send hornets ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites out of your way.
But I will not drive them out in a single year. If I did, the land would become empty, and the wild animals would become too many for you.
I will drive them out little by little, until you have grown in number and can take over the land.

I will set your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the River Euphrates. I will hand over to you the people who live in the land, and you will drive them out ahead of you.
Do not make any agreement with them or with their gods.
Do not let them live in your land, or they will cause you to sin against me. If you worship their gods, it will surely be a trap for you."
